articles.summary: Key Takeaways Three filters—revenue tier, funding model, and accounting platform—remove roughly three-quarters of vendors before feature comparisons. The core split is funded versus software-only. Funded models like TreviPay guarantee settlement timing and transfer collection risk. Bluevine reports that 91% of businesses improved cash flow after automating receivables. Blixo, Zoho Books, Versapay, and Quadient automate invoicing and collections without guaranteeing payment timing. Zoho Books has a free plan for businesses under $50,000 in annual revenue, capped at 1,000 invoices yearly. TreviPay targets enterprises seeking funded models and predictable settlement. The right choice depends on your bottleneck. Software-only tools suit businesses manually chasing payments. The 30-Second Pre-Filter
articles.title: How to Compare AR Automation Software Without Reading 18 Vendor Pages
